arxiv-2110-08266.title: PG 2 Net: Personalized and Group Preferences Guided Network for Next Place Prediction
arxiv-2110-08266.creator: Huifeng Li, Bin Wang, Fan Xia, Xi Zhai, Sulei Zhu, Yanyan Xu
arxiv-2110-08266.description: Abstract Predicting the next place to visit is a key in human mobility behavior modeling, which plays a significant role in various fields, such as epidemic control, urban planning, traffic management, and travel recommendation. To achieve this, one typical solution is designing modules based on RNN to capture their preferences to various locations.

arxiv-2208-09092.title: On Target-Oriented Control of Hénon and Lozi maps
arxiv-2208-09092.creator: E. Braverman a and A. Rodkina b
arxiv-2208-09092.description: Abstract We explore stabilization for nonlinear systems of difference equations with modified Target-Oriented Control and a chosen equilibrium as a target, both in deterministic and stochastic settings. The influence of stochastic components in the control parameters is explored. The results are tested on the Hénon and the Lozi maps.

arxiv-2307-13053.title: Bipolar thermoelectrical SQUIPT (BTSQUIPT)
arxiv-2307-13053.creator: C. Guarcello, R. Citro, F. Giazotto, A. Braggio
arxiv-2307-13053.description: Abstract We theoretically study the quasiparticle current behaviour of a thermally-biased bipolar thermoelectrical superconducting quantum interference proximity transistor, formed by a normal metal wire embedded in a superconducting ring and tunnel-coupled to a superconducting probe. In this configuration, the superconducting gap of the wire can be modified through an applied magnetic flux.

arxiv-2404-05043.title: Optimizing Privacy and Utility Tradeoffs for Group Interests Through Harmonization
arxiv-2404-05043.creator: Bishwas Mandal, George Amariucai, Shuangqing Wei
arxiv-2404-05043.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Bishwas Mandal, George Amariucai, Shuangqing Wei. We propose a novel problem formulation to address the privacy-utility tradeoff, specifically when dealing with two distinct user groups characterized by unique sets of private and utility attributes. Unlike previous studies that primarily focus on scenarios where all users share identical private and utility attributes and often rely on auxiliary datasets or manual annotations, we introduce a collaborative data-sharing mechanism between two user groups through a trusted third party.

arxiv-2409-19577.title: The Universe according to DESI results
arxiv-2409-19577.creator: Davide Batic, Sergio Bravo Medina, Marek Nowakowski
arxiv-2409-19577.description: Abstract The recent fit of cosmological parameters by the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI) collaboration will have a significant impact on our understanding of the universe. Given its importance, we conduct several consistency checks and draw conclusions from the fit.

arxiv-2501-15385.title: DDUNet: Dual Dynamic U-Net for Highly-Efficient Cloud Segmentation Thanks: This research was conducted with the financial support of Science Foundation Ireland under Grant Agreement No. 13/RC/2106_P2 at the ADAPT SFI Research Centre at University College Dublin. The ADAPT Centre for Digital Content
arxiv-2501-15385.creator: Yijie Li 1 , Hewei Wang 2 , Jinfeng Xu 3 , Puzhen Wu 4 , Yunzhong Xiao 2 , Shaofan Wang 5 , Soumyabrata Dev 4,6
arxiv-2501-15385.description: Abstract Cloud segmentation amounts to separating cloud pixels from non-cloud pixels in an image. Current deep learning methods for cloud segmentation suffer from three issues. (a) Constrain on their receptive field due to the fixed size of the convolution kernel. (b) Lack of robustness towards different scenarios. (c) Requirement of a large number of parameters and limitations for real-time implementation.

arxiv-2505-03377.title: Gene finding revisited: improved robustness through structured decoding from learned embeddings
arxiv-2505-03377.creator: Frederikke Isa Marin, Dennis Pultz, Wouter Boomsma
arxiv-2505-03377.description: Abstract Gene finding is the task of identifying the locations of coding sequences within the vast amount of genetic code contained in the genome. With an ever increasing quantity of raw genome sequences, gene finding is an important avenue towards understanding the genetic information of (novel) organisms, as well as learning shared patterns across evolutionarily diverse species.

arxiv-2602-02406.title: Provably Data-driven Multiple Hyper-parameter Tuning with Structured Loss Function
arxiv-2602-02406.creator: Tung Quoc Le, Anh Tuan Nguyen, Viet Anh Nguyen
arxiv-2602-02406.description: Abstract Data-driven algorithm design automates hyperparameter tuning, but its statistical foundations remain limited because model performance can depend on hyperparameters in implicit and highly non-smooth ways. Existing guarantees focus on the simple case of a one-dimensional (scalar) hyperparameter. This leaves the practically important, multi-dimensional hyperparameter tuning setting unresolved.

pmc-10832023.title: Mycoplasma infection aggravates cardiac involvements in Kawasaki diseases: a retrospective study
pmc-10832023.creator: Guoyan Lu, Xing Li, Jie Tang, Yuxi Jin, Yang Wang, Kaiyu Zhou, Yifei Li
pmc-10832023.description: Background Mycoplasma pneumoniae (MP) infection serves as a substantial cofactor in Kawasaki disease (KD) among patients. Although the dominant issue triggering KD has recently focused on MP infection, the complete demonstration of the relationship between MP infection and KD remains elusive. This study endeavors to scrutinize and compare the clinical manifestations and cardiac involvement between MP-triggered KD and non-infection–associated KD.

pmc-11286971.title: Predicting the epidemiological trend of acute hemorrhagic conjunctivitis in China using Bayesian structural time-series model
pmc-11286971.creator: Guangcui Xu, Ting Fan, Yingzheng Zhao, Weidong Wu, Yongbin Wang
pmc-11286971.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). This study aims to explore the application value of the Bayesian Time Structure Sequence (BSTS) model in estimating the acute hemorrhagic conjunctivitis (AHC) epidemics. The reported AHC cases spanning from January 2011 to October 2022 in China were collated. Utilizing R software, the BSTS and Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average (ARIMA) models were constructed using the data from January 2011 to December 2021.

pmc-11461893.title: Ultra-high voltage gain achieved with quadratic DC/DC converter design
pmc-11461893.creator: Preeti Sharma, Sara Hasanpour, Rajneesh Kumar
pmc-11461893.description: This work introduces a novel DC/DC converter with an incredibly high voltage gain, specifically designed for renewable energy generating systems. The proposed circuit features a coupled inductor integrated with a quadratic boost circuit and a voltage multiplier cell to achieve a substantial step-up in voltage gain.

pmc-11646867.title: Infiltrative Myocardial T-Cell Lymphoma
pmc-11646867.creator: Alexander Podgorski, Daniel Tardo, Callum Cherrett, Orly Lavee, Jason C Kovacic
pmc-11646867.description: We report a unique case involving cardiac manifestation of T-cell lymphoma and associated risk management of ventricular arrhythmia and sudden cardiac death. A 39-year-old woman presented with a syndrome consistent with fever in a returned traveler, ultimately diagnosed with stage IV peripheral T-cell lymphoma involving the myocardium with ventricular tachycardia.

pmc-12565956.title: Does Early Orthodontic Treatment in Mixed Dentition Improve Long-Term Outcomes? A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
pmc-12565956.creator: Yousef Majed Almugla, Madiraju Guna Shekhar
pmc-12565956.description: Background and Objectives: Early orthodontic intervention during the mixed dentition phase is commonly used to intercept developing malocclusions and potentially reduce the need for more complex treatment later. However, there is limited and conflicting evidence regarding the long-term stability of such early interventions, particularly in comparison to delayed treatment or no treatment at all.

pmc-12776183.title: SNX24 serves as a potential prognostic biomarker and a therapeutic target in uterine corpus endometrial carcinoma according to bioinformatics and experimentations
pmc-12776183.creator: Delai Long, Xiaodong Fan, Yingjun Zhu
pmc-12776183.description: BackgroundUterine corpus endometrial carcinoma (UCEC) which is originated from endometrial epithelium, ranks the second among frequent malignant tumors in female reproductive system. The discovery of novel therapeutic targets is urgently needed to address unmet clinical demands. In this study, we conducted a comprehensive bioinformatic analysis to identify key drivers of UCEC.

pmc-12824307.title: Multivariate data analysis of sex differences in emotional and cognitive evaluations over 1 year after stroke
pmc-12824307.creator: Suhrit Duttagupta, Thomas Tourdias, Sharmila Sagnier, Mathilde Poli, Sabrina Debruxelles, Pauline Renou, Stéphane Olindo, Igor Sibon, Sylvie Berthoz
pmc-12824307.description: Post-stroke disabilities in cognition and mood lead to worse stroke recovery trajectory but are frequently overlooked. Although neurological factors and clinical history have been documented as important predictors of these invisible handicaps, the role of sex has not been given enough scrutiny. Examining sex-based differences in these outcomes could help deliver better post-stroke care.

pmc-13079685.title: Cluster analysis and risk prediction model construction for antisynthase syndrome-associated interstitial lung disease based on clinical, imaging, and antibody characteristics
pmc-13079685.creator: Jin Zhang, Wenfeng Gao, Baoting Chao, Minghua Huang, Yuyu Yang, Ying Zhang, Rongzhen Xia, Yiting Lin, Kaining Gao, Wei Xu, Qingrui Yang
pmc-13079685.description: ObjectiveInterstitial lung disease (ILD) is a common and serious complication of anti-synthase syndrome (ASS), exhibiting high heterogeneity. This study aimed to stratify patients with ASS-associated ILD (ASS-ILD) based on their clinical features, high-resolution computed tomography (HRCT) findings, and specific antibody profiles. We also aimed to build a predictive model for severe ASS-ILD to help identify it more accurately.

pmc-13266593.title: The association between visceral fat indices and diabetic peripheral neuropathy in type 2 diabetes mellitus: A retrospective cross-sectional study
pmc-13266593.creator: Nesibe Aydogdu, Emel Sabaz Karakeci

pmc-13416471.title: High frequency chest wall oscillation for airway clearance in bronchiectasis
pmc-13416471.creator: Imad BouAkl, Jana Bazzi, Antonio Esquinas, Mohamad El-Khatib
pmc-13416471.description: Bronchiectasis is a chronic inflammatory airway disease characterized by impaired mucociliary clearance, persistent mucus retention, recurrent infections, and progressive airway destruction. Airway clearance techniques (ACTs) are central to the management of bronchiectasis, aiming to interrupt the cycle of mucus stasis, infection, and inflammation.
